findings.claim: AXT Q2 2026 call: expects to exit 2026 at ~$60M quarterly InP capacity and to more than double to ~$130M in 2027 with an additional adjacent-site expansion; CEO said could pursue more than the planned doubling; InP backlog 'well over $100 million'.
findings.source: MarketBeat, AXT Q2 earnings call highlights

findings.claim: AXT Q3 2026 call: surpassed goal to double InP capacity in August; expects ~2.75-3x end-2025 capacity by end-2026 and to double again in 2027; definitive private-equity financing agreement for InP and raw-material capacity expansion in China via Tongmei.
findings.source: MarketBeat, AXT Q3 2026 earnings call transcript

findings.claim: Peers expanding rather than constraining: Sumitomo Electric reportedly plans ~3x InP substrate capacity 2024-2028; JX Advanced Metals reportedly 7-10x by 2030 (unconfirmed against primary filing; another source says no announced plan).
findings.source: Substack / aggregated reports via search (the indium phosphide squeeze; Global Semi Research)

findings.claim: New China competitor project approved in Zhejiang: ~RMB 2B investment, planned 3M GaAs and 3M InP substrates/year, construction Aug 2026 to Aug 2029.
findings.source: TrendForce News, GaAs and InP Substrate Project Approved in Chinese Zhejiang Province

note: Excerpts not verbatim-captured; no peer capex figures from primary filings. Tight market commentary says shortage may last to 2028 (secondary sources).
